title: vs-reference-part-composer: context passes measured against the reference composer (Wave Q)
method: arrangement-benchmark/v1 run twice on the identical synthesised corpus, one flag apart (contextAware off vs on)
corpusNote: PR-18's synthesised corpus — the kind of music this pipeline finds easy. A small improvement here is weak evidence; a regression here is strong evidence. Q-00's real corpus is where a real verdict comes from.

verdict.summary: CONTEXT_AWARE_ARRANGER regresses playabilityErrors — do not promote

recommendation.reason: CONTEXT_AWARE_ARRANGER regresses playabilityErrors on the synthesised corpus; a regression here is strong evidence. The contextAware flag stays off.

whatWasFoundAndFixedFirst.firstRun: criticScore 74.56 -> 47.22, playabilityErrors 0 -> 66.11. The harmony re-voicing pass was re-voicing every part — including basslines and drum-adjacent parts — onto an inner voice of a four-part SATB chord, dragging basslines up into piano register where they were then clamped and collided.
whatWasFoundAndFixedFirst.fix: applyHarmonyPlan now re-voices only harmonic-bed roles (pads, sustained keys, string beds, comping); a bassline, drum part or lead line keeps its own octave and contour. Same-pitch unisons the re-voicing still creates within one bed part are collapsed. enforceHardConstraints now also thins a chord thicker than the instrument's maxSimultaneousNotes, keeping the top line.
whatWasFoundAndFixedFirst.afterFix: 8 of 9 cases at playability 0 and critic within ~1 point of baseline; only orchestral-midi still regresses (0 -> 62).

remainingRegression.likelyCause: Two string/brass section-role parts for the same instrument each emit a legal narrow voicing, then both re-voice toward the same shared plan and merge into a chord past the section instrument's simultaneity limit. The per-part polyphony guard runs before the orchestrator merges parts by instrument, so it cannot see the combined load.
remainingRegression.properFix: Apply the polyphony ceiling after the per-instrument merge, or share one bed voicing across all section-role parts of an instrument rather than re-voicing each. Not done here: forcing this case green by tuning a threshold would be gaming the gate the plan exists to respect.

honestLimits: The verdict is do_not_promote. The context passes are not yet better than the reference composer, even on the easy corpus.
criticScore is the pipeline grading itself — a proxy, not a listener. buildBlindComparisonSheet produced 9 anonymised pairs from these two runs; no human has judged them.
The style grammar slot was empty in this run, so the groove pass never ran. This measures the voicing plan and the arranging passes, not Q-02's groove.
One corpus, synthesised. This is the measurement infrastructure working and returning a negative result, which is a result.
